correctness.rationale: The radial one-essential-vertex tree model supplies connected 1-dimensional homotopy and H1 rank =1-C(n+m-1,m-1)+(m-1)C(n+m-2,m-1); the Euler generating series for r fixed arms is (1+(1-r)t)/(1-t)^r, with r=0,1,2 verified directly. For an arm permutation with c_l cycles, invariant unordered configurations split into clopen components indexed by complete l-point orbits on each nonfixed cycle; each factor over radial coordinates is an open-interval unordered configuration space, contractible, and the remaining points lie on the c1-arm fixed star. Thus the fixed Euler generating function is (1+(1-c1)t)prod_l(1-t^l)^(-c_l). A finite equivariant CW model and finite-order Lefschetz give trace H1=1-chi(fixed space), proving the all-m,n character. Averaging over S_m, the ordinary and marked-point cycle-index identities yield 1-p_m(n)-p_m(n-1)+sum_{j<n}p_{m-1}(j). Direct independent bounded partition recurrence yields zero for n=1,2,3,4 and one for n=5 across m=3..8; algebraic bounded-partition identities show this holds for every m>=3. Inspected complete signed-cell Abrams checker over 66 finite permutations; its finite cases cannot prove the universal assertion.
